kept.title: NFKC Normalization May Create Ambiguities
kept.description: Using NFKC normalization for URLs can collapse characters in ways that are not consistent with the host's actual domain resolution, leading to 'homograph' type vulnerabilities.
steps_to_exploit: Register a domain that looks similar to an internal service under NFKC normalization
Pass this domain to the validator
The validator evaluates the normalized domain while the browser/client requests the literal domain
kept.impact: Confusion and bypass of domain-based filtering.
